verdict.rationale: Missive publishes an llms.txt index at https://missiveapp.com/docs/llms.txt, and items fetched from that URL show real per-page entries. Every docs page also serves raw Markdown when '.md' is appended to the URL, giving agents direct machine-readable docs. The probe 404s are at the root /llms.txt and /docs.md paths, which are not where the index lives, so they show weak discoverability rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the conventional root /llms.txt path, an OpenAPI spec for agents, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.
